subject: Shared roadmap: commitments, blockers, and target close
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.inference>
To: Natalie Huang <natalie@helioshealth.com>, Alex Torres <atorres@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Shared roadmap: commitments, blockers, and target close

Hi Natalie / Alex —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we have a single reference (I attached an editable MAP export and a short SOW draft):

1) Business objective
- Reduce inference latency for EHR summarization workloads to sub-300ms p50 for 512-token runs; target peak throughput of ~40 qps for pilot.

2) Proposed milestones (high level)
- Pilot kickoff & access (Redwood onboarding) — target: 9/20 — Owner: Helios IT (Alex) + Sean (Redwood)
- Integration & security review (SOC2 evidence + network) — target: 10/01 — Owner: Helios Procurement (procurement@helioshealth.com) + Marissa (Redwood)
- Pilot performance tuning (quantization + batching) — target: 10/15 — Owner: Redwood Eng (Ben)
- Pilot validation & sign-off (quality/latency/cost) — target: 10/29 — Owner: Helios Clinical (Natalie)

3) Dependencies / blockers we discussed
- Helios must provide a sanitized sample dataset and dev VPC peering (security sign-off) — Alex
- Procurement needs SOW + pricing band to start purchase order — procurement@helioshealth.com

4) Ask / next actions (this week)
- Natalie: confirm target pilot user group and expected sample size by 9/15
- Alex: share the VPC peering contact + IP allowlist details by 9/16
- Procurement: confirm SOW path (contracting team contact) and timeline

I attached: Helios_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (draft with milestones and owner column) and SOW_Draft-Helios.pdf (placeholder commercial terms). I will drop a weekly checkpoint note next Friday to keep things moving.

If anything above is off, please flag edits inline in the MAP and I’ll pick them up.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Helios_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (workbook), SOW_Draft-Helios.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: Shared roadmap: commitments, blockers, and target close

Thanks Sean — nice summary. Quick notes:

- Pilot user group: 25 clinicians in outpatient summarization (we'll give a 2-week sample of de-identified notes); confirm by 9/15 (I will send sample size details).
- VPC peering: I'll introduce our cloud infra lead (Alex included) to your network engineer in a separate thread — expect that intro 9/13.
- Procurement: forwarding to contracts team. Procurement will need a finalized SOW and a pricing band to raise a PO; current rough timeline is 3–4 weeks once SOW is approved.

Two asks from us:
1) Can you add a column in the MAP for "legal/contract dependency" (yes/no) next to each milestone?
2) Are you able to provide a summary of what SOC2 artifacts you can share this week?

Appreciate the cadence — looking forward to the intro.

—Natalie
Natalie Huang
Director, Clinical Innovation | Helios Health
Natalie.Huang@helioshealth.com

Hi all — weekly checkpoint and gentle nudge. I updated Helios_MAP_v1.2 with the following changes based on earlier notes and in-thread edits:

- Added "legal/contract dependency" column and flagged the procurement milestone as REQUIRED.
- Marissa uploaded a short SOC2 artifact list (redacted) into the Drive link (see related links).
- Ben uploaded the first-pass tuning notes (high-level cost estimates) to the MAP tab.

Outstanding / overdue items we still need to avoid schedule drift:
- Natalie: confirm the final pilot sample delivery date (still listed as "TBD" in the MAP) — requested by 9/22 to keep pilot kickoff on 9/30.
- Procurement: procurement team action to provide contracting contact or PO process confirmation (marked as overdue) — any ETA?
- Alex: any update on VPC peering contact and timeline?

If we can close the items above this week, the plan keeps us to a 9/30 pilot kickoff and an October validation window. If procurement needs more time, please propose the earliest available close date so we can update the MAP and shift internal owners.

I'm happy to jump on a 20-minute call if it helps unblock procurement or VPC scheduling. Proposed times: 9/20 10:00–10:20am PT or 9/21 3:00–3:20pm PT.

Thanks — appreciate the teamwork.
